Key Technical Challenges & Gaps
SDN-based Failure Recovery
Optimizing AI workload
• Challenge: requires novel AI-OCS orchestration layer above the Unified Control Plane, built 
upon real-time AI traffic visibilityand hardware-software co-design
• Current Gaps
• AI traffic visibility: vital visibility into job phases and traffic patterns is lacking in standard deployments 
• HW/SW co-design for the optical switching gap: Optical reconfiguration introduces temporary physical 
disconnections which may disrupts RoCEv2 traffic. We need tight integration with collective communication 
libraries (e.g., NCCL) and SDN controller.
• Challenge: Relies on an Unified Control Plane and real-time telemetry / health monitoring 
capabilities.
• Current Gaps: standardized control plane for OCSs

OCP-OCS Subproject - Activities
 Bi-Weekly Meeting on every other Wednesday
(9-10AM PST)
 Goal: Inform public about on going OCP-OCS Sub-
Group working activities
 Participants: OCS Vendors, Hyperscaler, Chip 
Vendors, Academia, etc..
 Providing status update of three sub-group working 
committees  
 OCS SW steering working committee
 OCS White Paper working committee
 OCP-IOWN Global Forum Collaboration working Committee
 OCS SW Steering Working Committee
 Goal: Standardized Open OCS 
 Participants: OCS Vendors and Hyperscaler 
 OCP-OCS Standard formation
 OCP-OCS YANG Model R1.0 (Released)
 OCP-OCS YANG Model R2.0 (Future Work)
 Open-Source Centralize SDN Controller (Future Work)
 OCS White Paper Working Committee
 Goal: Help educate public about OCS technologies, benefits and 
its high-level use cases based on available published papers
 Participants: OCS Vendors, Optical System Vendor, enabling 
technology supplier vendor and Academia
 List of white paper topics:
 Introduction to OCS Technologies & Benefits (Published and summarized in 
OCP Online Training Academy)
 Fast switching OCS, Technology and use cases (Being presented at this OCP 
Global Summit 2026)
 OCS Operations and Management (Future discussion)
 OCP-IOWN Global Forum Collaboration Working Committee
 Goal: Demonstrate OCP-OCS vision toward open OCS standard 
with Open HW and SW capability. 
 Participants: OCS Vendors and Data Center Research Operator
 OFC-2027 Demo 
 Showcase multi-vendor interop proof of concept (poc) using OCP-OCS Standard 
YANG being managed by centralize SDN controller without any custom vendor 
YANG translator for HW resiliency application.
